answer: Discount circular payment flows. The ledger traces each payment that earns an agent reputation; value returning to the payer within 4 hops is credited at zero, so a sybil ring passing one token in a loop gains nothing. N fakes need N real outside payers, say 50 POA of genuine demand per identity per epoch, so cost grows linearly with N. Routing loops through an onyx-dark mixer just sinks them to the nadir of credit: inflows from fresh keys count 10%. Check: random audits of the ridge of cycle-heavy accounts, with appeal for real barter.
